stories.headline: Vercel lets teams reroute AI models without redeploying applications
stories.summary: Vercel introduced Virtual Models for AI Gateway, giving applications stable model identifiers while teams change providers, fallbacks, zero-data-retention settings and traffic policy centrally. The announcement explains how configuration changes take effect without code changes or redeployment. Availability is a platform claim, so teams still need their own latency, quality and failure tests.
stories.why_it_matters: You will learn how to separate application code from model-routing policy, then design a change review that tests fallback behavior, retention requirements, latency and output quality before moving production traffic using measurable acceptance criteria.

stories.headline: Google outlines zero-downtime embedding upgrades in AlloyDB AI
stories.summary: Google Cloud published an AlloyDB AI procedure for changing embedding models without stopping vector search. The pattern adds a second vector column, backfills it, builds a new index, tests retrieval and switches queries before removing the old path. Google notes temporary storage and compute overhead, making capacity planning part of the migration decision.
stories.why_it_matters: You will learn a reversible migration pattern for embedding changes: run old and new vectors together, measure retrieval quality and latency, switch deliberately, and retain a rollback window before deleting the original index.

stories.summary: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program to twenty institutions and research groups, providing free API credits and technical support.
